title: Maximum Sum of Alternating Subsequence With Distance at Least K
goal: Solve Maximum Sum of Alternating Subsequence With Distance at Least K: Activate distant predecessors, query opposite-direction DP states, and reconstruct an optimal zigzag subsequence.
strategy: Activate distant predecessors, query opposite-direction DP states, and reconstruct an optimal zigzag subsequence.

phasePurposes.start: Initialize rising and falling DP states.
phasePurposes.activate: Insert index i − k into the eligible predecessor trees.
phasePurposes.rise: Extend a falling state with a strictly smaller endpoint.
phasePurposes.fall: Extend a rising state with a strictly larger endpoint.

edgeCases: Equal values cannot extend a strict rise or fall; predecessors must also be at least k indices away.
inputRules: Enter {"nums":[...],"k":1}: 1–100,000 values in 1–100,000, and 1 ≤ k ≤ nums.length.
